verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You brought my life with the
Blood that You shed on the cross

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
When You died for the sins of men
And You let out a cry
Crucified now alive in me

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
These hands are Yours
Teach them to serve as You please

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
And I'll reach out desperate to see
All my greatness of God
May my soul rest assured in You

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
I'll never be the same
No I'll never be the same

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
Cause I know that You're alive
You came to fix my broken life

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
And I'll sing to glorify
Your Holy Name
Jesus Christ

verse.name: v4a
verse.lines:
You changed it all
You broke down the wall
When I spoke and confessed

verse.name: v4b
verse.lines:
In You I'm blessed
Now I walk in the light
In victorious sight of You

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Your fire fall down
Fall Down

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
On us we pray
As we seek

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
Show me Your heart
Show me Your way
Show me Your glory
